items.title: Carnatic violinist HN Bhaskar charged with four sexual offences against minor in California
items.summary: Carnatic violinist HN Bhaskar is facing four felony charges in a criminal case filed before a California court. The charges relate to alleged sexual offences involving a minor between September 4 and 26, 2026. The case was filed on November 6 before the San Diego Superior Court. According to the court’s online records, Bhaskar faces two counts of oral copulation of a person under 18 and two counts of sexual penetration with a foreign object involving a victim under 18. The court records also show that a warrant was issued on November 6, the day the complaint was filed. The San Diego Superior Court confirmed to TNM that the complaint lists four charges and that the alleged offences took place “on or about and between September 4, 2026 and September 26, 2026.” The court said no date had been scheduled for Bhaskar’s arraignment and that he had not made any in-court appearances as of November 21. It could not confirm whether he was in custody. However, a source told TNM that Bhaskar is currently in custody at a jail in Boston, Massachusetts. The court's Public Affairs Office told TNM that this was possible and said he could also be awaiting an extradition hearing for his transfer to Ca
